summary: Production readiness gates are mostly review and evidence driven. This pack enforces only Gate 4 metadata requirements that map directly to Terraform plan resource tags and labels.

input_schema.description: Terraform plan JSON (terraform show -json). Policies read resource_changes[].change.after and inspect tags or labels on planned resources.

controls.title: Azure required metadata tags present and meaningful
controls.source_section: ## 9. Gate 4 — Metadata / Azure Considerations / Common Failure Conditions
controls.obligation: Nile-managed Azure resources must include the required metadata tags and must not use placeholder values.
controls.iac_check: For azurerm_* resource_changes on create/update, require non-empty after.tags values for owner, created-by, cost-center, environment, function, service, repo, applicationname, name, notificationdistlist, ssp, trproductid, and apmid; reject placeholder values.

controls.title: GCP required metadata labels present and meaningful
controls.source_section: ## 9. Gate 4 — Metadata / GCP Considerations / Common Failure Conditions
controls.obligation: Nile-managed GCP resources must include the required metadata labels and must not use placeholder values.
controls.iac_check: For google_* resource_changes on create/update, require non-empty after.labels, google_container_cluster.after.resource_labels, google_container_node_pool.after.node_config[].labels, and google_sql_database_instance.after.settings[].user_labels values for owner, created_by, cost_center, environment, function, service, repo, application_name, name, notification_distlist, ssp, tr_product_id, and apm_id; reject placeholder values.

controls.title: Source control and review evidence exists
controls.obligation: Infrastructure artifacts, pull request references, ownership, and review history must be source-controlled and reviewable in GitHub.
controls.reason: Requires repository, pull request, and review-record evidence outside Terraform plan JSON.

controls.title: Identity posture reviewed and justified
controls.obligation: Identity model, service account or managed identity approach, access posture, and static credential usage must be reviewed and justified.
controls.reason: The document frames this as review evidence and architecture posture, not concrete universal Terraform-plan attributes across all resource types.

controls.title: Network exposure review completed
controls.obligation: Public exposure, firewall posture, connectivity model, and exceptions must be reviewed and documented.
controls.reason: Requires cross-resource topology review and documented exceptions beyond plan-only checks in this generic gate document.

controls.title: Data protection posture reviewed
controls.obligation: Encryption, secure transfer, key management, and public exposure posture must be reviewed for applicable services.
controls.reason: High-level review requirement without uniform, document-specific Terraform attributes that can be safely enforced across clouds and services from this file alone.

controls.title: Logging and monitoring evidence reviewed
controls.obligation: Logging destination, audit logging, alert routing, retention, and monitoring ownership must be documented and reviewed.
controls.reason: Evidence and operational ownership requirement, not a uniform Terraform-plan assertion from this document.

controls.title: Threat detection coverage reviewed
controls.obligation: Threat detection tooling, findings routing, accountable owner, and alerting path must be documented and reviewed.
controls.reason: Process and operating-model evidence requirement outside Terraform plan JSON.

controls.title: Backup and recovery posture reviewed
controls.obligation: Backup posture, recovery objectives, and exception rationale must be documented for applicable resource types.
controls.reason: Requires applicability and recovery-objective evidence not represented uniformly in Terraform plan JSON.

controls.title: Privileged access risk reviewed
controls.obligation: Owner and admin roles, custom roles, guest usage, and emergency access paths must be reviewed and documented.
controls.reason: Review and governance requirement requiring identity/role context beyond generic Terraform plan inspection.

controls.title: Policy exceptions documented and approved
controls.obligation: Exceptions must include control name, scope, owner, rationale, risk, compensating control, approval, expiration, review date, and evidence link.
controls.reason: Exception workflow schema lives in GitHub/process records, not Terraform plan JSON.

controls.title: Human approval recorded before production-impacting deployment
controls.obligation: GitHub pull request review, linked findings, linked validation results, and human approval must be present before production-impacting deployment.
controls.reason: Human approval and PR evidence are external workflow artifacts, not Terraform plan fields.

controls.title: Graduation evidence package complete
controls.obligation: Architecture records, governance findings, validation evidence, exceptions, operational ownership, telemetry evidence, backup evidence, metadata evidence, and final approval must be complete before graduation.
controls.reason: Composite evidence package requirement spanning documents, approvals, and operations records outside Terraform plan JSON.
